children: LSB Industries, Inc. (“LSB”), (NYSE: LXU), today announced that its Chief Financial Officer, Cheryl Maguire and its Chief Commercial Officer, Damien Renwick will be participating in the following conferences:
UBS Global Materials Conference on Wednesday, September 9th in New York City
Jefferies Industrials Conference on Thursday, September 10th in New York City
Ms. Maguire and Mr. Renwick will be available for one-on-one meetings all day at both events. To schedule a meeting please contact your sales representative at the host firm.

LSB Industries, Inc., headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, is committed to playing a leadership role in the production of low and no carbon products that build, feed and power the world. The LSB team is dedicated to building a culture of excellence in customer experiences as we currently deliver essential products across the agricultural, industrial, and mining end markets and, in the future, the energy markets. The company manufactures ammonia and ammonia-related products at facilities in Cherokee, Alabama, El Dorado, Arkansas and Pryor, Oklahoma and operates a facility for a global chemical company in Baytown, Texas.
